  • Description

    ”13 Kilometers from the Tunnel” is a psychological thriller about a group of first-year students who find themselves in the village of Luragarak. What at first seems like an ordinary visit quickly turns into a nightmare when mysterious deaths begin to occur in the village. As they try to understand what is happening, they become drawn into a dangerous story where fear, suspicion, and the boundaries of reality grow increasingly blurred. The deeper they go into the village’s secrets, the more they realize that getting out may be far more difficult than they ever expected.
